notes.title: Skystead Ranch V1.1.15 Patch Notes
notes.notes:

[h2]New Features [/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]New "Move Skylet" Spell[/b] - Available to purchase fairly early in the game. This new utility spell allows you to pick up and move Skylets about your Skystead. Note that Skylets will break out of the spell if you try to move them to areas where they don't want to be (we don't want you dropping them off the edge). Hopefully, this highly requested spell will help people shift Skylets that are trying to escape downstairs 🙂
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixing and Misc[/h2]
[list]
[*] Controller is now fully working as intended in the keeper shops.
[*] Fixed an issue where the controller UI selection wasn't working in the pause menu or Settings menu in the cave.
[*] You can now use Q+E or controller equivalents to change the size of the rock terraforming tool as intended.
[*] You can now close crook spell selection menus by pressing B (or whatever non xbox button layout you might have).
[*] Many Skylet requirement changes to better balance and ensure all Skylets are available to unlock.
[*] Spore[list]
[*] Max food amount has been increased from 5 to 12 (and the food burndown rate adjusted accordingly) to prevent Spore from being fully fed from 1 or 2 items with the Mushroom tag.
[*] Added Nocturnal tag.
[*] Changed preferred Day Type to Night.[/list]
[*] Truffle[list]
[*] Added Nocturnal tag.
[*] Changed preferred Day Type to Night.[/list]
[*] Loona[list]
[*] Changed Spawn Condition requirement from ">= 1 Fire" to "<= 1 Fire" to stop conflicts with its own Wandering and Taming requirements.[/list]
[*] Spook
[list][*] Changed Tame Condition from ">= 2 Fire" to >= 2 Light" to stop conflicts with Loona for Wendi's multiple Nocturnal Spawn requirements.[/list]
[*] Snarl
[list][*] Changed Tame Condition requirement from "= 0% Rock" to ">= 10% Rock" to stop conflicts with Fjord's Tame Condition requirements (Both Dinos are needed on the same island for the Dino achievement).[/list]
[*] Mewmew
[list][*] Added Nocturnal tag.

[*] All Day Time Skylets now sleep for the entirety of the night.
[*] Skylets who like Both day and night have more unique sleeping patterns. Some will sleep during the morning, some later in the day and some at night, keep an eye on your favourite Skylet to work out when it goes to bed!

notes.title: February Developer Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]It's been a busy few weeks![/h1]
We want to say another massive, heartfelt thank you to all of you for playing, reviewing and enjoying our game! We have been hard at work addressing all of your feedback and hope you've been enjoying the improvements we've been implementing to Skystead Ranch.

From the now usable chests, new camera controls and numerous bug fixes, we are proud of what we have been able to add to Skystead Ranch in a few short weeks! We hope you've enjoyed these changes too and would love to hear your thoughts on what we've implemented as we believe there is always room for improvement! 💖

Here's a breakdown of what else we've been working on and what to expect in the coming weeks.

[h1]Preparations Begin for Sky Island Events and Parties![/h1]
Something that has been on the roadmap for Skystead Ranch since almost the beginning, is seasons events! With Easter just around the corner, we have begun preparations for the first major in-game event!

Firstly, we need a place for the events to be delivered! Check out the new Event Pier large buildable spot that Laura is working on, it's still a work in progress so check it out in the game when the events begin to see the final product.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/08accb0a2d94793b8892be492b08b89ffd9017b4.png[/img]
[h2]Yolk[/h2]
With the first event being our Easter Eggstravaganza, we of course are adding an Egg-based Skylet! Check our Yolk which Jack created on stream last week! The VOD of this stream is available on our YouTube if you want to see more in-depth behind-the-scenes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/4a386b82f0b6595e19c750a24a7b1372807827fe.png[/img]
We don't want to give too much away about the event before it goes live, so check back in April to see what magical activities we have in store for you!

[h1]A Free Beach Island Update[/h1]
A huge thank you once again to our Kickstarter backers who got us over the line for our Beach Island stretch goal! With your help, we are now able to create a whole new island for you all to play on and find even more exotic Skylets!

Coming in the next couple of months is a whole new, free addition to Skystead Ranch. Make sure you have the lift and water wheel built to take the trip down to the beach along with brand new Sand and Deep Water spells! 😎

These new spells will be crucial for you to attract a whole new array of Skylets! Jack is working hard right now to get these cute additions ready! If it loves the hot sands or cool deep water, you can expect to find it with the new additions to your spell book!

This is Nessi, a large, water-based Skylet that you will have to learn how to attract and befriend!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/2e8810a391b92a21e73a2220bafa826d2e4dcaac.png[/img]

As you can see, they are still a work in progress (hence not having any eyes yet!), but it hopefully gives you an idea of what you can expect with this free addition coming soon!

[h1]Player House Progress[/h1]
Another big request from you all is the player house which we are very excited to get working as we planned! Laura has been crafting a variety of in-house furniture for you all to buy and build when the house becomes usable!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/f4b079943c1dbe527949be14a66860c63898e494.png[/img]
You'll notice there are a variety of beds, this is due to the request from players to be able to pass the time quicker when you want day or night to come back around! We didn't originally plan for the ability to skip time in Skystead Ranch but your request for this makes sense to us and so Laura is laying the groundwork for Rob to add this with the rest of the house implementation.

Let us know what you think of the designs!

[h1]What's Coming Next?[/h1]
We're working around the clock to get the roadmap promises implemented along with all of the important bug fixing, so thank you all for your patience in getting this ready! We still have a few bits to do to get up-to-date with the roadmap and these will be getting added in the coming updates.

Rob our programmer is taking a much-needed break over March since he is over 200 hours over his work hours! That's real dedication and we know he needs to take time to fully relax and recuperate. This means there won't be any updates throughout next month, but you can expect to see a whole bunch of big exciting things in April when he's back and ready to go!

Thank you for your understanding and we wish Rob the best break ever to get back to normal! 💖

[h2]Skystead Merch[/h2]
A little treat we've been working on outside of game development is some Skystead Ranch-related merch! From embroidered hats to mugs and posters, we have some exciting things in the pipeline! Keep an eye on our news and website for when these go live to purchase so you can represent your Skylets outside of your Ranch!

notes.title: Roadmap for Skystead Ranch
notes.notes:
[h1]Our Development Roadmap[/h1]
Thank you to everyone who has played the game and left valuable feedback! Be that from directly messaging us on Discord or by leaving a game review, we are working to take it all on board and include your suggestions or frustrations into the development plan for Skystead Ranch.

We hope to make Skystead Ranch as enjoyable as possible for all of you and lift any worries or curiosity about the future of our game.

Your bug reporting is taking priority on what we will change first, but additional features and overall gameplay changes are also on the to-do list. We've broken down the updates into weekly updates, check out the breakdown here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/b6efb95e846e7287805c4db9f37328b21d3d25a0.png[/img]

[b]Please Note[/b]: Like with all of our games, we like to give players the choice of using new features and changes. So for most of the features and changes listed below, there will be a toggle setting (in the settings menu) to allow you to revert back to the original controls etc.

[h2]This Week:[/h2]
We've already released a Monday patch for some weekend-reported bugs and quick changes, check out the V1.09 Patch notes at the bottom for details.

[b]Bugs or problems we're fixing:[/b]
[list][*] Buying an item from the shop whilst holding an item causes you to lose both items.
[*] The game feels laggy when playing on uncapped FPS; We're going to add graphical settings to give you better control over the FPS.
[*] Skylet hunger bar drops too quickly.
[*] The controller is not working in the shop.
[*] Getting stuck going in and out of the mine; We will make the game spawn the player further in the mine, preventing being pushed out or accidentally leaving.
[/list]
[b]Features and changes we're making:[/b]
[list][*][b]Radial menus and the Field Guide are slow at loading in and out.[/b]
[*] [b]Adding a night-time Skyship[/b] to stop progression stagnation when the Ship leaves for the day; this will be a Street Light upgrade on the Skypier, we don't want them crashing into the island after all![/list]
*The Next two changes are big changes so will likely see progressive updates over the coming weeks, but implementation will begin this week.
[list][*][b]Adding Chest Storage[/b]; We hear your feedback on needing the ability to hold more than one item at a time as well as the option to clean up your dropped items. We are going to add a global chest storage system (Think Ender-Chests in Minecraft) so you can build chests throughout your Sky Island, any items you put in any chests will be accessible from all of the chests you have built. [i](Additional features like Storage organisation and Shop-to-Chest linking can be considered and implemented once we get the main storage system released.)[/i]
[*][b]Camera control rework[/b]. This is a big one, both from your feedback and the work needed to address, so thank you for your patience in getting this rolled out. This is two-fold, firstly we are going to look at the fixed camera angles and add a solution to allow players to have more freedom in looking around, including being able to look up and down! Secondly, and more importantly, we're going to redesign the camera controls and feel when using the Crook modes for terraforming, building and destroying/digging. We're thinking of implementing more of a "God-mode" camera when using these spells to make it more intuitive. We'll be grateful for more feedback once it's released.[/list]

[h2]Next Week:[/h2]
[b]Bugs[/b]
These bugs are penned in for next week as they require more diagnosing from us before being able to be fixed, that being said, if they get fixed earlier, we'll push the fixes earlier too. 🤞
[list][*] Building in the cave is glitchy, some built items will be floating when you re-enter the cave and some are deleted altogether.
[*] Can't build the Mountain Path after paying for all the upgrades in the shop. [/list]
[b]Features and Changes[/b]
[list][*] [b]More Tutorial;[/b] this was something that fell behind in development due to us underestimating the amount of work needed to add Voice Lines to every stage of the tutorial. We are using this opportunity to add in what you have mentioned you feel is missing from helping you understand what to do next, as well as what we already had planned to add/complete the tutorial.
[*] [b]Being able to cancel out of the petting Skylet animation[/b]
[*] [b]Reworking the Multiuse crops (and carrying system), like Carrots and Candy Corn[/b]; We were never 100% on the circular health icons that show in the bottom left when carrying the carrots (or other multiuse crops) so we're planning on changing how the crops are carried. We're going to add the ability to physically stack items in your hands, so if you interact with 5 carrots to pick them up, your character will be running around with a precarious, tall stack of carrots in their hands that can be fed or planted individually.
[*] Adding a warning message to the shop for Large-Buildables that don't unlock new islands (yet).
[*] Adding a setting to allow you to reduce the frequency of how often Skylets say their own name.
[*] Adding a setting to allow you to change "Hold R" to "Toggle R" to open and close the radial menus.[/list]

[h2]February:[/h2]
No bugs here! Just new features. That being said, we will still prioritise any bugs that get reported between now at February which will potentially affect the implementation of new features slightly.

[b]Features and Changes[/b]
[list][*] [b]The House![/b] We're so sorry this wasn't ready in time as it is such a big part of the game progression, This will be fully added in February with all interior upgrades.
[list][*] A Bed/Bedroom to pass the time from day to night or night to day (Not on our initial design for Skystead Ranch, but something that is requested and fits the game)[/list]
[*] [b]Working Skylet Feeders[/b]; Items with the "Feeder" tag (like the Wooden Troughs) are intended to be able to be filled with food, allowing you to easily feed your island full of Skylets.
[*] [b]Reworking the Tool Sound Effects[/b]; we were never fully set on the SFX for the spells, and it's something you've noticed too.
[*] [b]Reworking the Farming, Dig > Grow > Harvest loop[/b]; Having to harvest your crops, put them down, re-dig the hole, and then pick up and plant the crop again can be tedious when you have a larger farm (I'm tired just reading that process). Therefore we are going to make it so the holes from harvesting crops remain dug which will significantly reduce the work, and click load of the player. You will be able to harvest and replant in just 2 clicks of the mouse.
[*] [b]Rebindable Keys[/b]
[*] [b]Selling unwanted items[/b]; By the start of February you will be able to store items in a chest, use them, or bin them - why not sell them too?
[*] [b]Working Sundials[/b]; Another feature we have had on the backburner is sundials to tell when day/night is coming. The way we are going to implement this feature is, if you build a sundial on your island you will get a UI indicator that matches the sundial and shows how long is left until dawn/nighttime (Don't question how sundials work at night). If all goes the plan, the sundial icon will change depending on what Tier of Sundial you have added and might even be more accurate if you build more expensive sundials.
[*] [b]Better/New Farming indicators[/b]; Right now if you plant a crop or tree too close to something else and it doesn't have room, it will stop growing, we will add some element of UI or indicator to show that a plant can no longer grow in it's current conditions. With enough time we will also add the following:
[list][*] Indicators for how long is left for the current crop to grow to the next stage.
[*] Watering your crops to speed up growth; This will not be a penalising mechanic, crops will not die if they are neglected, they will just grow faster when tended.[/list][/list]

[h2]Beach Island Update:[/h2]
Post-Febraury, we will be looking to launch our Beach Island Update, a free addition to the game courtesy of our Kickstarter backers helping us reach a stretch goal!
[h3]Beach Island[/h3]
That mysterious Lift and Waterwheel upgrade will be needed to access the Beach island. This island will be underneath your existing Sky Islands and will be the key to unlocking both Deepwater and Sandy biomes, both of which will be needed to attract up to 10 more elusive Skylets that love to bask in the sun or catch the waves! 😎
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/e4a92521fa0f6a745d64dfc3b810517d97e0b243.png[/img]

With this update, we will be looking to also add the following Features and Changes:
[list][*] [b]Upgrades to your spells[/b]; Right now once you have a new spell like the meadows spell for example, you can use it to its full capacity. From your feedback, we are re-adding an idea we discussed in early development where you can upgrade all of your spells. This means new spells will only be available in smaller sizes and you will have to unlock and upgrade your spells to be able to cast them in wider areas. This will give you a sense of progression as you become more skilled in your use of growing grass or summoning rock.
[*] [b]Skylet Houses[/b]; These can be built and are currently only decorative items that improve the appeal of your island, we want them to function as actual Skylet houses where the linked Skylet will sleep, and maybe even lay eggs or produce materials.
[*] [b]Making untamed (or unwanted) Skylets leave your Island[/b]; 🥺 This is a mechanic in Viva Piñata (Which we used as inspiration for Skystead Ranch) that we purposefully left out of Skystead Ranch as we thought it was mean, that being said, your islands can indeed become cluttered with grey Skylets you have no interest in befriending, therefore we will add some buildable items, like Totems or other Scarecrows, that will prevent each type of Skylet from wanting to enter your Ranch.[/list]


[h2]Additional Suggested Changes:[/h2]
The following are suggestions from your feedback that we are not adding to Skystead Ranch (yet) and our reasons why. But we are open to discussion regarding these features and want you to know we are listening to everything you say and are happy to work with you to make Skystead Ranch a game we all dream of.
[list][*] [b]Quests[/b]; This is a great idea, especially for expanding the purpose of the Shops and can be tied to unlocking new items and spells. However, some of the requests for this are to help guide you on what to do next, hopefully, the finished tutorial will help you with this instead. As well as this, a quests system would be a very large addition to the game and require a lot of resources to implement - we need to make smart decisions on what to focus our efforts on as a small Indie Games Studio.
[*] [b]Charatcer Customisation[/b]; A highly requested idea that we would love to be able to add. However, similar to Quests, we just don't have the scale at the moment here at ToastieLabs to add customisation. We made the decision early on in development not to add this for this exact reason. We'd not only need to design, model and texture each custom option, but we'd need to fully re-do all of the animations to make sure each custom item doesn't clip or bug. You never know, if we get lucky and see some serious growth in our team, we'd love to revisit this option.
[*] [b]Sprinting or Running[/b]; A request in relation to help speed up the gameplay, we made a conscious decision in developing and designing Skystead Ranch not to have a running feature in order to lean more towards the cosy and relaxing feel of the game. Nothing in Skystead Ranch should be pressing or urgent enough to require you to run to it in time. We hope that addressing the night-time issues and storage/carrying abilities will help you agree that running just isn't a needed feature.[/list]

I will emphasise though, that we are always open to discussion. We like to be as transparent as possible here at ToastieLabs and love to hear your input. Please comment on this post or join our [url=https://discord.gg/toastielabs-750363631279014079]Discord[/url] to chat about your ideas and feedback. Thank you! 

[h1]An Apology Gift from the Devs[/h1]
Thank you again for playing Skystead Ranch and giving us your valuable feedback.

We, like you, are not 100% happy with the condition of the game on release and want to apologise for the rushed result of the launch. We know we can do better.
As well as fixing the issues reported, we want to offer you a free game update that will add a whole new "thing" to the game for you to enjoy.

Please vote in this Strawpoll to have your say in what we can add to Skystead Ranch to best apologise to you. https://strawpoll.com/X3nkPAXdPgE


From all of the devs here at ToastieLabs, Thank you! 💖

notes.title: Buy Skystead Ranch Now!
notes.notes:
[h1]The Day Has Finally Come![/h1]

We've made it! The launch date for Skystead Ranch is here! Skystead Ranch is now live on both Steam and Epic Games for everyone to install and play!

A massive thank you to each and every one of you who helped us get to this momentous day for our little Northern Indie Games Studio.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/3f5335e301020baeab6ac4bb1788dd9752278a13.png[/img]
Whether you're a long-time fan, someone we met at Comic-Con or EGX, or just a supporter who stumbled across our little Kickstarter campaign or game store page, we want to send you a massive thank you and all our love, from all of us here at ToastieLabs. 💖

[h1]It's Time to Play![/h1]

The game will finally be available for everyone to play! We invite you to play Skystead Ranch along with us as we are Broadcasting on the store page where we will be live-streaming the game ourselves for the next hour or so!  If you haven't already, make sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/toastielabs-750363631279014079]Discord[/url] where the discussion with the devs can continue through the weekend. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2399570/Skystead_Ranch/

Tell your friends, tell your family, tell whoever you like! This is just the beginning of the next chapter for Skystead Ranch and the success you help bring will allow us to make the game bigger and better as we go further into 2025.

[h1]Skystead Ranch is all about the Skylets![/h1]

If you are still here to learn about Skystead Ranch, let us tell you a little more about the game.
Skytead Ranch is a creator collector where you control your own ranch to create the perfect homes for the cute creatures we call Skylets!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/de4ce859cb7962d7bd4cbd14a4f9a38c55d6b2dd.png[/img]

Each Skylet has its own unique set of needs and requirements; it's up to you to learn about them all and make the island a perfect balance to attract the Skylets you want on each island!
With elements of farming, cooking, fishing, and terraforming; you have all the tools at your disposal to provide for all the cute Skylets that come your way!

[h1]What to expect next[/h1]

As we said, this is just the beginning. We still have a variety of things to work on and implement so there's more to look forward to. 
[list]
[*] Nintendo Switch porting in March*
[*] A Beach island with 10 new Skylets (Thanks to the stretch goal on Kickstarter!)
[*] The player house interior
[*] Chests with inventory
[*] Functional feeding troughs and sundials
[*] More smaller updates we'll be sure to share in patch notes
[/list]
So make sure to check back for updates on Steam, Discord, and all the usual places to see what's coming up next!

Depending on the success of the launch, we may be able to be even more ambitious, but that is optimistic talk; we'll see how the next week of sales goes! 🤞

[h2]Skystead Soundtrack[/h2]

A lot of smart design went into the music for Skystead Ranch. As you terraform an island, keep an ear out for the subtle music changes during the day as the instruments that play the music will be vary to match the different biomes and terraformed land types!

The store page is available here and will be live from the 23rd of January:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3437920/Skystead_Ranch__Soundtrack/

[h1]Thank you[/h1]

Once again, we cannot thank you all enough for your support. The game legitimately would not be as large as it is today without all of your support. So a massive thank you from all 5 of us here at ToastieLabs, we can't wait to see what the future holds with you along for the ride.

Make sure you stop by the Steam store page today and tonight to watch the madness of our live stream as the whole team will be swapping in and out to play Skystead Ranch and hold a few last-minute giveaways.

- As always, sent with love from the ToastieLabs team <3

notes.title: Floors and Progress and More!
notes.notes:
[h1]Christmas Season with Skystead Ranch![/h1]
November is always a busy month here at ToastieLabs, we made it even busier this year by adding all of this Skystead Ranch development on top! We're inching ever closer to a finished game, thank you to everyone who has played the Beta so far and given us valuable feedback! 
Find out more below.

[h1]Floor and Building Improvements[/h1]
The most exciting change has been from Rob who has implemented a long-awaited change to the building mechanics. 

Changes such as placing flooring under objects and directional arrow UI for objects that face in a certain direction will allow you to get even more creative with your builds and add that extra flair of personality to your Skystead Ranch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/d9379ed70d6ca18bd88121b856295545d0bf496d.png[/img]
Buildable objects have all been revisited with this "flooring or not flooring" pass to make their occupied space better fit the actual shape of the object. This means odd-shaped objects can now be placed closer to other objects, and most excitingly, the mini bridge can now actually be a bridge to go over your other designs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/e6bb5713155ad0bf8abdf1d09d2cefd05e6f449a.png[/img]
Get building and show us what you come up with, we can't wait to see your creations!

[h1]Cooking is Finished! (Almost)[/h1]
We've done it, it's finally complete! Cooking is fully implemented into the game, all recipes, all foods and all whacky combinations have been added to try! (untested) 

There are still some minor things to do, such as UI implementation to tell you when the cooking is done, adding the recipe book that Laura has created so you can know what you can make and most importantly, actually testing that every recipe is set up correctly in the game!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/41777850e99651f832c061174da65fdbdb0f62f2.png[/img]
[h1]Recreating the Tutorial[/h1]
Rob has been re-designing the tutorial as we have been handing out Beta access to our Kickstarter backers! (Thank you again 💖)

Our previous tutorial was from over a year ago as so much has changed in the game that it no longer applies! A lot of work and design thinking is needed to get this perfect but the feedback that has been provided so far from our backers has been pivotal in making sure we hit the mark - thank you for your feedback in Discord, please keep it coming!

[h2]Controller Support[/h2]
Work has been going ahead on controller support as we start to pave the way for Nintendo Switch and Steam Deck support. Jack has been making all the relevant UI changes so you will always know what buttons to press no matter what controller you are using.

Rob has been painstakingly adding all of the implementation for the new controller UI, which is a personal favourite of his (sarcasm). 

[h1]New Skylets![/h1]
As always, Jack has been hard at work finishing up the list of Skylets, meet the final 2 Skylets for the release of Skystead Ranch!

Fjord (right) is a big, long-necked Skylet who thrives in the colder reaches of your Ranch, their long hair keeping them warm in the strongest of winds. But they are rather shy and can be tricky to entice into a new home!

Peggy (left) is the rarest Skylet we know, they will only appear on Skysteads that already have a vast variety of Skylets for them to make friends with as they hate to be alone! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/8815ba74ff757c39da15846ec9ade197bda4800b.png[/img]
Left: Peggy - Right: Fjord

[h2]Wormy![/h2]
For any of you who have been following our development from the very beginning, do you remember Wormy? 

Wormy was one of the 2 test creatures for the very early prototypes of Skystead Ranch to test if the game idea was possible - but they were left behind as we continued with the development and were replaced by Shelly.

But not any more! Jack dug him out of the depths of the folder structure where he had been buried and recreated him to better fit the game as it is today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/17937e4422ddc3d76e2b238a171355e1cde3393e.png[/img]
What a cute little guy he is!

[h1]Nintendo Switch Release Delays[/h1]
An update for those of you who are waiting to get Skystead Ranch on the Nintendo Switch, we are sorry to say that we have hit some unexpected delays with getting the game working well on this console. We are still confident that we will be able to release Skystead Ranch on the Nintendo Switch, but due to these delays and the turnaround time needed for Nintendo, the game will not be released on Switch at the same time as we are releasing on PC. If you are a Switch Kickstarter backer, don't worry we are still hoping to send you keys at the same time as PC backers so you shouldn't be impacted too much.

We will update you further with an exact date when we know more. Thank you for your patience!

Skystead Ranch is still releasing on Steam on the 17th of Jan, that's only [b]38 days[/b] from the posting of this update! 😱

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2399570/Skystead_Ranch/

Please wishlist the game if you haven't already and tell your friends about us!

With love, the ToastieLabs team <3

notes.title: Player Animations and Music Production!
notes.notes:
[h1]Spooky Season with Skystead Ranch[/h1]
The team have been hard at work as ever making more content, more animations and even more progress towards our release goal in January! 

Read below for more details and official confirmation of the release date for Skystead Ranch!

[h1]Player Animations[/h1]
We started on this last month, but we are proud to share that we have all of the revamped player animations in-game and working smoothly! It took some fine-tuning from our programmer Rob to get them all lined up as intended, but now the animations are all looking great and transition between each animation smoothly.

From running, to digging, to even petting the cute Skylets all around your Skystead!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/7e6c96f104bf4211e2d87e90183471a78e23b0f5.gif[/img]

[h1]New Mini-Trailers[/h1]
Not all work this month has been in the game editor. Lee has been making a variety of mini-trailers to help advertise Skystead Ranch to the masses! If you are here from any of the adverts we've shared on Reddit; Welcome! And don't forget to Wishlist Skystead Ranch now!

If you haven't seen any of the trailers but would like to watch them, find them [url=https://www.youtube.com/@ToastieLabs/shorts]here on our YouTube channel[/url]. 

[h2]105 Buildable Objects and 114 Items! 😲[/h2]
Laura, once again, has surpassed all expectations and has been adding more and more 3D assets to the ever-lengthening list of Skystead Ranch "things".

Rob has finally had the time to start importing all of the assets and setting up the long list of prefabs to be used throughout the game design.

We have a staggering 105 buildable objects and 114 items that the player and Skylets can use, and this list is still growing as Laura continues to work into the back end of October! See all of the items that we were able to add in the last week below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/8e115557ece366423f48fe5ed3a18f7d921a3ac4.png[/img]
It's not just small items that Laura has been working on, more of the large in-world areas have been re-adressed too! Check out the Fishing pier below, now with added upgrades.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/ed0e637e74d8871df32e73536acb65b5480b05ac.png[/img]
We realised the fishing areas we placed into the game were another area we could add to the player experience by providing players with more choices to upgrade and customise in-world areas.

[h1]Game Music[/h1]
Even more exciting news, we have started the commissioning of the game music for Skystead. We already have 2 pieces back and they are sounding great!

With a desire to be more ambitious and creative, we are working with the idea of an over-arching main piece of music that plays throughout and will change as you go from one biome type to another making the background ambient music thematic and changeable. 

Once we have more music back, we will start adding this to the game and can hopefully show you what we mean!

[h1]New Skylets![/h1]

notes.title: Adding Photo Mode!

We are so close to the release of the game, it's exciting! Schedules have been re-assessed and we're ready to hit our goals!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/365c2799cb2210e4752140eb25e2d8d8e8142292.gif[/img]

notes.title: More Skylets, More Big 3D assets and even more Saving and Loading!
notes.notes:
[h1]Feels like we're almost there![/h1]
There has been a lot of back-end progress this month that makes us feel like the end is in sight! But there is still plenty to do so stay tuned for more and more updates as we get ever closer to release. 💖

[h1]Spells and Saving[/h1]
A large part of having a magical crook to farm and terraform your Skystead, is to be able to cast spells.
As of the creation of the prototype, all spells have started unlocked for the player to use, allowing you to make whatever you like right from the start of the game. 

Although freedom of choice is important and fun, the current setup wasn't particularly good for game progression, we want you to feel like you are achieving goals and unlocking rewards. therefore we have begun work on tying the spell unlocks to the tutorial and to the game shop. As you progress through Skystead Ranch, more spells will become available leading to more variety of Skylets being attracted to your floating islands!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/104b090a6d64eb8248e37d03115b13d92664cb41.png[/img]

As you can see, there is still a lot of work to be done on the shop layout to make it more attractive, but the functionality is there and the remaining work shouldn't take too long, touch wood! 🤞

Another of the spells we wanted to address was the ability to destroy items. This was already in the game but the issue we had was the aiming this spell was notoriously difficult as unlike the other spells at your disposal, there was no visual indicator to help you aim your spell.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/e81711f746cf8271c1aa51b98ed00e552770382b.png[/img]

A small temporary UI has been added to show you where you are aiming, this effect will also snap to a nearby object, making your aiming that little bit easier as well. Small changes have been made to the particle effect too, see if you can spot it in game.

A small update on the saving and loading from last month! More corrections and fine-tuning have been made to the functionality - you can now delete saves to keep your game files clean! It's the little things that matter.

[h1]Importing Work[/h1]
A lot of work behind the scenes has been happening with Rob importing all (well, a lot) of the assets that our Artists have been working on over the past few months into the game engine. 
Our Patreons with access to our Trello boards will have noticed the art cards moving from left to right as they are being QA'ed and put into game!

[h2]Plushies[/h2]
Most of the new items are cute little plushies of the Skylets! These plushies will be linked to the Field Guide progress. The concept is, that once you have 100% of the information on a Skylet, you will unlock the ability to build a plushie of your favourite little friend that you have spent so much time learning about.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/f81e16a83d1634b33cd34b3157419036e84b2368.png[/img]

Here are a couple of examples, have a look in Sandbox mode if you want to see more!

[h1]Player Character Bag![/h1]
Remodelling and Retexturing work has been done on the bag that your player character carries on their hip.
This was a task that needed doing to provide the promised reward to those of you who backed our Kickstarter back in October with one of the Pet tiers (or above) - A huge thank you once again to those of you who helped us reach that goal!

Jack spent some time editing the model of the Bag to make variations for the Cat, Dog and "Animal Lover" Tier rewards that you will have in the game only if you backed at one of these tiers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/fc570336c0f4bdcb90a1befdee35091a5a7b286d.png[/img]

When tackling this task, Jack also took a moment to retouch the original texture for the basic bag design to better match the new bags which are now being textured in Substance Painter instead of directly in Blender.
If you would like to see Jack making these bags, you can find the VODs of the Livestream where Jack worked on there [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bicxSZj-vf8&list=PLYTYbT7ploFzYgK3w_mQT93pPQsDwp1QK]here[/url].

[h1]Bigger Assets than before![/h1]
Our artist Laura is back from her holiday and working harder than ever! She has been working on the "large assets" that are found around the Sky Islands. The first of the tasks was to finish and/or break the large assets Jack has made. These include the Lift and Water Wheel which will be unlocked throughout the game and will eventually provide you access to new islands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/e6da0cbbdbc2f9b80448aac18e7adb404a7361e8.gif[/img]

The lift itself was a little tricky in the fact that we had to find a way to create a working elevator that does not look modern or use electricity. We managed to find a number of references in both real-life history and other fantasy settings to create this finished product, which we think, looks like a working lift whilst keeping that mystical yet rustic flair.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/86417e947745a836377a7ab2ddeaed7bfa766347.png[/img]
We say "working" but you can't ride the lift just yet!

The largest, and arguably most important of the big assets, is the player house! You may be aware from previous posts that the house itself was finished a long time ago with work even being done on the interior of the house too. But what we wanted to address was the house upgrades. The player house will be able to be upgraded in size as well as add on important room extensions, each that will serve its own purpose, from a greenhouse to grow crops in a more controlled environment, to a library to keep a record of all your hard work and progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/0d32bd55f6c84200ee1ad653e665f6565435f52b.png[/img]
We wanted the house upgrades to represent their purpose from the outside as well as inside, and we hope we've achieved this here, let us know what you think!

[h1]New Skylets![/h1]
As always, the bit you've been waiting for. New Skylets!

Meet Wendi and Rhoss.
Wendi is based on the Wendigo from folklore but made 100x cuter! A hound like Skylet with a skull hiding its real face. This Skylet can only be found at night and appears to have many mysterious markings, I wonder what they mean? 🤔

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/241e0bb37511c8553479b82b551647437f185239.png[/img]
Left: Rhoss, Right: Wendi

Rhoss is not fully finished, hence the lack of eyes to see where it's going! But don't worry, I'm sure by this time next week he'll be rolling around as happy as ever. A rolling rock covered in moss - Rhoss. Creative right? This little fella was designed because we thought something that rolled around the sky islands instead of walking or running would be super cute and we just wanted to give it a go!

[h1]Thank you![/h1]
As always, thank you all for your support! 
Share Skystead Ranch with your friends and make sure it's added to your Wishlists! Beta is getting closer along with more demos to try out. Keep an eye out for more news on this in the future.

notes.title: Inside Zones, New Skylets and Save Files!
notes.notes:
[h1]Heating up in Summer![/h1]
Summer is here and the weather is not the only thing getting hotter! 😎

We have begun work on some of the exciting and much-needed areas of the game such as the long-promised inside zones and the vital, highly-requested, save files!

More details below.

[h1]Inside Zones[/h1]
Rob has been hard at work adding the interior areas for the player house and cave on the beginning Skystead Ranch Island. Both areas are completely separate instances so some programming magic has been needed to ensure smooth unloading of the main playing area whilst loading the interior zone instance - this is made more complex with the save files which have also begun over the last month!

A lot of work went into the player camera to ensure you can see inside as you rotate the camera. 👀

We took inspiration from games like Sims and worked out how to make the walls between the character and the camera disappear to allow you to see inside. We're sure some improvements can be made so we will be looking for your feedback when you get hands-on with future demos.

[h2]House[/h2]
If you have played any of our demos, you will be familiar with the player house that you have been able to walk up to but not enter. Well, now you can!
Our artist Laura spent a couple of weeks designing the tileable wall assets so Lee and Rob could get down to designing the layout of the player house and considering its purpose.

Layout below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/a3d706d2d798bbb5fe3dc59fbf4a5b2a87af1c69.png[/img]
[i]*This player house links directly to player progression which will be started next on the roadmap[/i]

As you can see, a lot more work is needed to finish the house, but the starting idea is now in the game. You will start with a small room for your basics, a bed, maybe some storage and a little decoration. Then as you progress you can make the room bigger and even add more rooms for utility! 

A Greenhouse to grow complex plants in your own house, a kitchen to progress further in the cooking mechanic and even a trophy room to showcase all of your fully unlocked Skylets (currently just a shrine to Shelly, we will add every Skylet to this room we promise!)

[h2]Cave[/h2]
Unlike the house, the cave is a zone for Skylets and farming, just like the outside islands.
The cave was an idea from very early development as we like the idea of a darker zone where all the Skylets who normally only come out at night will be able to live all day long without worry of the sun rising. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/31fccd32252c1c6f02b323658683d0de8c8d5de7.png[/img]

As caves are generally dark and damp, we have decorated the area with a variety of wonderful and whacky mushrooms, moss and other fungus-like vegetation - some of it even glows in the dark! 🍄

The keen-eyed of you will have noticed a big crystal-like gem in the screenshot, we are planning on adding a little bit of game lore and player progression to things you will find within the cave - more about that in future updates! 🤫


[h1]Saving and Loading 💾[/h1]
This is a feature we knew we'd need no matter what - but something we are taking even further due to taking your feedback on board about wanting to have a Sandbox mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/78293769ff0ebf0e2c476a792885090d8bb0bfbb.png[/img]

Unlike our previous games, we are developing separate save files for Skystead Ranch within the same game, allowing you to have many different Skystead Ranch save files on the same account! This is important for allowing you to play around in Sandbox mode and then switch over to the story mode without worry of losing either saved island. 

Due to the more complex Save Files, we are learning a lot and there is still a lot to do to get saving and loading working correctly. Check back in future updates to see how we've gotten on - good luck Rob! 🤞

[h1]New Skylets[/h1]
Onto the cutest bit! New Skylets! 🥺
Jack has been Modeling, Rigging, texturing and animating like a madman!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/32b8c92aaa70e23d4521c7d7947a08eb36f9aa60.png[/img]
[b]Left:[/b] Thaw       [b]Right:[/b] Skipling

Last week alone saw the implementation of 2 brand new Skylets! 
Thaw is an ice golem-inspired Skylet that is related to the Bau and other elemental Skylets, it'll probably be a bit trickier to find than the others due to its [i]slippery[/i] nature. 🥁

The Skipling is the last of our Kickstarter backer Skylets, a huge thank you to our backers who supported us at this tier and helped us get their own designs into Skystead Ranch! 💖
This cute little bird will skip around your Skystead and has an eye for the shiny stuff! Keep your precious shiny items out of its reach or it might just take them to its nest for safekeeping.

[h1]Thank you![/h1]
As always, thank you all for your support! 
Share Skystead Ranch with your friends and make sure it's added to your Wishlists! Beta is getting closer along with more demos to try out. Keep an eye out for more news on this in the future.

notes.title: Tutorials, New Mechanics and More!
notes.notes:
[h1]We're in Alpha![/h1]
That's right! We have officially moved into Alpha with Skystead Ranch. That means a select few people can play Skystread Ranch right now! If you are one of those with access, thank you so much for your feedback so far, it has been invaluable. 

For everyone else, Beta is just around the corner so more and more of you will be able to get early hands-on play testing experience of Skystead, and we can't wait for you to see what we have done.

[h1]Cooking and Fishing![/h1]
We have officially committed to adding Cooking and Fishing as mechanics to the game! A huge shout out to our volunteer, Cameron, who prototyped the mechanics to demonstrate the work needed to add them to Skystead Ranch.

Our artist Laura has already begun making various models to process the ingredients for cooking! 
[i](Note: These are still a work-in-progress and missing textures)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/5075e6fe2288c0e9a0e6fff450b669279cd76c8e.png[/img]

[h2]What purpose will fishing and cooking serve?[/h2]
To ensure that the added mechanics fit the game and aren't just added on for extra content, we are integrating both the fishing and cooking into the Skylets behaviour, likes and dislikes - because, after all, your Skystead Ranch is all about your Skylets!

By adding the ability to crush, mix, chop and cook food, we are unlocking the potential for a much wider variety of food options for your Skylets, allowing you to spend more time with your favourite Skylets to discover what each wants the most and allowing each to have the best Skylet diet possible! 

Fishing is still a WiP too, so more info on that soon! 🎣

[h1]Gameplay Changes[/h1]
Using your valuable feedback from the Steam Farming Fest, we have made a multitude of changes to Skystead Ranch - so thank you to everyone who filled out the feedback form or chatted with us in [url=https://discord.com/invite/toastielabs-750363631279014079]Discord[/url]!

[h2]Sandbox Mode[/h2]
Added as a way to showcase the game during the farming fest, we asked if you would like to see a Sandbox mode in the full game, and you overwhelmingly said "Yes!" so we've kept it and made it neater on the Main Menu.

[h3]What is Sandbox mode?[/h3]
Essentially a way to play Skystead Ranch without worrying about unlocking anything or having a need for resources! Enjoy the Ranch life with unlimited resources and access to everything from the get-go to build and terraform any scene you like without having to maintain a farm or manage your Skylets.

[h2]Longer Day and Night[/h2]
A small change, but important based on your feedback, is the day and night cycle has been made longer! 
This allows you to get more progress made per day and enjoy the nighttime Skylets for longer at a time. This will be more important when we add more and more night-time-based Skylets!

There is still work to do on this as we need to re-calculate the growth times of all crops and trees to align better with the new day lengths.

[h2]Tutorial[/h2]
We already knew we needed a tutorial in Skystead Ranch, but thanks to your comments, we have pushed this up the timeline drastically! Originally planned to be developed in September, we have already begun work on the Tutorial now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/11146cbadb82bfae47b9fc07a4e1f4728fe9a8d7.jpg[/img]
Currently, the tutorial takes you through the basic controls and how to use the Crook, but we are still working on the next stages, such as resource management and meeting the Skylets. 
[i]Voice-over work for the Tutorial will be added again at a later date.[/i]

[h1]Thank you![/h1]
Thank you to everyone for your continued support and interest in our Skystead Ranch development! Make sure you wishlist the game if you haven't already, and keep an eye out for more news soon!

[h1]Farming Fest[/h1]
Big news! We're taking part in the Steam Farming Fest this month!

Some are very small, some can even fly, but all of them are as cute as can be!

[i][b]From left to right:[/b] Sizzle, Puffle, Tor, Bigby, Snarl[/i]

"Shiny" skin variants are also in the works as we are also improving upon the rare Skylet spawning! We have been changing up the colour pallet and adding emissive textures to give them that extra rare glow!

[h2]Forest Zone[/h2]
The second of the playable zones, like the starting island, is designed for you to farm, upgrade and discover new Skylets! The forest zone will be more lush than the first island with vibrant trees, dense undergrowth and all the wonderful Skylets that come with it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/3e7caa797619f88a1fe2505d849ffeef2ea72a6c.png[/img]

[h1]Performance Improvements[/h1]
With all the new additions to the game from the art department, we have been making sure we don't fall behind on the technical side too! Our programmer has been hard at work ensuring the frame rate, loading times, and other performance requirements are as polished as they can be.

One big step was reworking the 3D grass model! Updates to the grass shaders allow for lifelike movement without taxing the drivers and a change in the way the grass is rendered allows us to have a lot more grass density for a lot less performance cost.

Just look at that sweet grass!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/fa79ccfb96d050f09302faabe1281655b479b813.png[/img]

[h1]Steam Deck and Controller Support[/h1]
Our motivation for performance improvement was twofold. It is important for us to provide a better game overall, but we are also excited to make sure Skystead Ranch is console-ready too!

We officially have a Steam Deck here at ToastieLabs! What that means is we are now able to officially support Skystead Ranch (and our other games) on the Steam Deck as we can do in-house QA testing on the Deck which we weren't able to do before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/7e3d01bccfccacbe39a08ac1106f62a23c5ac2b2.png[/img]

With plans for Skystead Ranch releasing on the Steam Deck and Nintendo Switch, we have begun work on controller support as well as classic keyboard and mouse. Make sure you plug in your controller or play on your Steam Deck this month when the Demo goes live and let us know what you think!

[h1]New Controls[/h1]
"With controller support comes new controls" - Uncle Ben or something

[h2]Camera Controls[/h2]
Taking your feedback on board from the Next Fest back in October, as well as considering the player experience when playing with a controller, we have completely overhauled the player camera for Skystead Ranch.
No longer is the game a top-down one-directional camera, but is now a 3rd Person camera with full 360-degree control! 

We're still working out the kinks when it comes to camera movement sensitivity, but the overall feel is much better for Skystead Ranch and we are very happy with the change. (Even if it does mean more work for the artists to fix the backs of the island that you couldn't see before, sorry Jack and Laura!)

[h2]Crook Controls [/h2]
The next set of controls to overhaul was the crook controls. The ability to dig holes, clear the earth and build items needed to be redesigned to fit with the new camera and controller support system. 

An updated building UI has been added which makes the building flow much easier!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/b4913df1e4dac4bafebbbd2521887c80b7e66d85.png[/img]
A lot of work is still needed to make sure this is ready for the demo, so best of luck to our programmer Rob!

[h1]Localisation[/h1]
To all of you non-native English speakers, we are very proud to announce that work has officially begun on localising Skystead Ranch.
The store pages and the base game are now translated into 11 additional languages!
[i]Please note: All of the localising still needs a thorough QA so there may be an issue or 2 until we get that all fixed for you.[/i]

[h2]Localised Languages: [/h2]

[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/ecd468a30f6d4c0fd92ca374a146c2f91db247ad.png[/img]
[h1]Your Turn![/h1]
Thank you for following our progress with Skystead Ranch! We invite you to play the demo from the 26th and let us know what you think!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2399570/Skystead_Ranch/

The game is still in early access so your feedback is very important to us. After trying the game, press the "Discord" and "Questionnaire" buttons on the game's main menu and let us know what you think in as much or as little detail as you like.

Thank you! 💖

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
[h1]January Development[/h1]
We've hit the ground running as we are starting 2024! To make the game as good as we can, we started this January by stripping down the demo you got to try last October back to the basics.

This allows us to have a second pass on everything, and ensure all files are in the correct place and following the right structure - overall, allowing for a better, more optimised game!
This is also the perfect opportunity to take your feedback on board and revisit some of the game fundamentals like the art style and game feel.

[h2]Publishers?[/h2]
Alongside the technical development, we are still in talks with various organisations to see about getting a publisher for Skystead Ranch, we are still hopeful of finding a publisher that aligns with our company values. We can't say much more on this at the moment, but will keep you all updated with any news we can announce.

[h1]New Artist[/h1]
The biggest news for ToastieLabs and Skystead Ranch this year so far, is our newest 3D Artist Laura! Going from 1 artist to 2 will greatly increase the quality and quantity of the assets we can create to flesh out the fantastical world of Skystead Ranch!

Laura is already settling in well with the team and has started strong with these new 3D models for the game! Her amazing work lets Jack focus his efforts on making many more unique Skylets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/fffd4b9671e776397baea757d9bec976867c6eb3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/8f54777c0cf6309c54c5c3cf84f9576e3247121e.jpg[/img]

[h1]World Block Out & Art Pass[/h1]
A large part of the development is revising the world layout, we concluded from the game Demo, that the starting world layout was far too large for tutorial purposes, with this in mind we have blocked out a brand new island layout, with the player house completely separate to the Skylet play area!

We are excited about the possibilities this unlocks from a gameplay point of view and are excited for you all to try it for yourselves in future demonstrations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/01ac82d14186af74544a4a6c4c475c015b51c255.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/2f0b2840555777b5ef1beb45a6454bddf87edaae.png[/img]

We put additional early development effort into the starting island to allow us to pass on the revisited art style to the publishers we are talking with. It's looking more and more like how we envisioned Skystead to look when we initially designed the game concept. Specifically the revised toon shaders we are using for the Skylets and improved lighting make for a much more cosy experience than we demonstrated in the demo. We also have a couple of new Sky Ships if you look closely.

Make sure you follow us on Steam and on our socials to stay up-to-date with the development process as we continue to make Skystead Ranch! We're still on track for release in early 2025!

notes.title: The Next Steps for Skystead Ranch
notes.notes:
[h1]Thank you![/h1]
We have not only reached but surpassed the goal to a staggering [b]133%[/b] of our target, to a satisfying £20,000 exactly! We are overwhelmed by the support we have received; it has been a wild journey this past month and we are grateful to have been able to spend it with such amazing people. Rest assured that any pledges over our target will really help us move forward as we go full throttle into game development!

In the last 60s, we hit our first stretch goal; as promised we can confirm that Skystead Ranch will get an additional [b]Beach Island[/b] including a new playable area, an additional 10 Skylets, new Sandy and Deep Water floor types, as well as a sprinkling of items and plants to accompany the new content. Thank you so much to the last-minute backers, we truly didn't believe we would hit this goal!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/cd8b7a0ed72f6194e89886fe000baf9baca863ba.png[/img]

[h1]Next Steps[/h1]
So the Kickstarter is over, along with all of the crazy events we have done this month. What do we do now?

[h2]1. Rest[/h2]
First off, most importantly for us here at ToastieLabs, we need some time to rest and recuperate! After the super busy month we've had this October we have certainly earned it. We are making sure all of the team have the time off they require to ease back into work. 

We've had 4 DLCs released for our other games this month, on top of EGX, MCM, Steam Next Fest, and the Kickstarter, so you can imagine just how busy we've been!

[h2]2. Other Games DLC and Taking Stock of Skystead Ranch[/h2]

Once the team is back to full strength, we are splitting into 2 groups to get the first, real step started! The end of the year for ToastieLabs brings with it a few extra game DLCs to release, including Advent Calendar DLCs for the whole month of December - so most of the team will be working hard to get these DLCs made and released on time.

We will also be getting the Backer Exclusive DLC made during this time so there will be plenty of time to Quality Test each DLC for release in early 2024!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/88034b1b7b44de572a4b36756a80186621bc292c.png[/img]

Meanwhile, Rob will start taking stock of everything we have in Skystead Ranch so we can thoroughly plan what is needed, what can be removed, and what needs a little fixing. 

Larger game features like Saving and Loading, Skylet AI, and better Player Controls are first on the to-do list.

[h2]3. 2024, Full Throttle for Skystead Ranch[/h2]

Come January 2024, we are hitting the ground running with Skystead development! We will be focusing primarily on the new Skylets we need for Skystead Ranch, starting with the Cat and Dog pets that are needed for you Animal Lovers who have pledged over £50, and the Game Designer custom-skylets for the 2 of you who have pledged the highest tier! 💖

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/c2491ba36cae965b73dc5a050fdced025c3a8f98.png[/img]

We want to ensure people who have Alpha access from the top tiers will also be able to play with the pets and custom-created Skylets, thus allowing us to get ample QA testing on the additional features the pets bring.

[h2]4. Investigate other means of Funding[/h2]

As this is our largest game project to date, we want to ensure Skystead has the best chance we can give it on release. With that in mind, we are going to investigate the possibility of getting a Publisher on board for the release of Skystead Ranch. We just want to give the game every opportunity possible in terms of marketing so more people will be able to relax with the final release!

A Publisher is a nice-to-have for us, but it is not a must-have for our game development, so if we are unable to find a suitable publisher for us to partner with, we will happily continue development as we are. We have done alright on our own so far, so we will only take on a publisher if they are a good fit.

[h2]5. Organise the rest of the road map and share it with you all![/h2]

This isn't everything! Come summer of 2024 we will have the rest of the development plan fully laid out, and we will continue to be as transparent as we can with you all so you know where we are going next! We will continue to drop update posts monthly here on Kickstarter to keep you updated on our progress.


[h1]Where we are Today[/h1]
Since the end of the Kickstarter Campaign, we have all taken the time to recuperate and are back on track with all of our projects. Make sure you check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/897330]Coloring Pixels[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1463920]hexceed[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1878910]WooLoop[/url] whilst you are waiting for Skystead Ranch!

We have also begun reaching out to a number of publishers, so fingers crossed on news regarding that soon.

Once again, we cannot say it enough - Thank you for all of your support! ❤️ You have all come together to make our dreams come true, and we are eternally grateful. We will take a nap now and get back to work very soon.

Lots of love - The ToastieLabs Team.

notes.title: Kickstarter, Steam Next Fest and EGX
notes.notes:
[h1]3 Weeks To Go![/h1]
There are just three weeks left in this Kickstarter campaign! That seems like a long time now, but the past 9 days have flown past for us, especially with the plans and activities we have in the coming weeks! Today we celebrated passing the 40% funded mark as we surged past 100 backers. Thank you so much for your continued support. It truly does mean the world to us; you are all incredible people <3

[h1]Steam Next Fest and EGX[/h1]
We kicked this week off with a bang as Steam Next Fest began! For those of you who don’t know, Steam Next Fest is an online-only event where many game companies show off demos for their upcoming games. Since our demo has been live for over a week now, it would seem silly not to join. The event runs all week but we decided to do two livestreams on Tuesday morning and Wednesday morning, both of which Lee got upwards of 2000 concurrent viewers!

As great as that has been, the event we are most excited about this week started today at the ExCel in London. EGX is one of the UK's biggest gaming events, where tens of thousands of people congregate to play games of all types, new and old. More importantly though, this year, Skystead Ranch has a stall with two PCs set up to play the demo! We unfortunately won’t be there in person, but we will be "manning" the stall remotely from our office in Gateshead through Discord.

Today’s first day of EGX was incredibly heartwarming. Our stall had people attending all day; in fact, we barely had time to reset the demo between visitors, and had people playing until after closing time. The attendees got genuinely excited about the game and were lovely (despite us being sat awkwardly in a webcam window). If you happen to be visiting EGX this year (as we know some of our community members are), then make sure to check our stall out and hop on the left machine for a chat if you like!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/97271125ef0a5cd83218969868285a37d53064ba.jpg[/img]
The EGX team did a great job handling the construction and setup of our stall, look for yourself!

[h1]Deluxe Edition Deep Dive[/h1]
In this update post, we wanted to go into depth on the Deluxe Edition tier on Kickstarter, what you can get, and what to expect. We want to be as transparent as possible, and a few bullet points in our graphics don't seem to be enough. After all, at the time of writing, it is our most popular backer tier - we know it's you Coloring Pixels fans out there isn’t it?

So, on top of everything in the basic “The Game” tier, you will be rewarded:

[list]
[*]  5 unique in-game cosmetics. We have some ideas on what we could do with this, from custom crook skins to visual effects cast from the character. Nothing is set in stone though, so if you have any suggestions let us know and we might just make it! We want to make sure that you have the option to equip them individually or all at the same time; we won’t be giving you 5 different types of shirts that you have to choose from.
[*]  Digital Wallpaper Collection. A set of HD files in various aspect ratios so you can liven up your desktop background, tablet, or phone screen! I know Jack is looking forward to making these.
[*]  Music Soundtrack. We have had some great feedback on the soundtracks that we have had composed for our demo, and for the final release, we are hoping to have a lot more types of music available. Different sets of tracks for the time of day and which part of the island seems like a logical next step for us. We will bring it together in a handy collection for you to listen to at your leisure!
[*]  Skystead Ranch-themed exclusive DLCs for three of our other games. We know this is what all the backers of this tier are after. We are happy to confirm that these DLCs will be full size, so 20 levels for Coloring Pixels, 21 for WooLoop, and a full world on hexceed, which we know varies in the level count but it will be on par. When the campaign is successful, we will begin working on these DLCs immediately. Jack will do Coloring Pixels, as always, and Lee and Icy will share WooLoop and hexceed.
[/list]
We hope to target the release of these DLCs for early next year, whereas the other parts of this tier will likely be available much closer to the game's release. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/88034b1b7b44de572a4b36756a80186621bc292c.png[/img]

Thank you to all of the backers of this tier, there are so many of you and we value each and every one of you. If you have any more questions about this tear, any of the other tiers, or Skystead Ranch in general, please get in touch as we will happily answer any questions!

In the next few announcements, we are hoping to do a deep dive into some of the various in-game features that are in the demo and additional ones that we are working on for the full release. Stay tuned!


[h1]Thank You so Much![/h1]
We know, we know, another thank you, but it cannot be said enough! None of this would be possible without every amazing person that is reading this now. We have begun work on a very important introduction to Skystead. We want to make sure the tutorial we offer is succinct enough that players can understand the early game flow without holding their hands too much.

notes.title: Welcome to Skystead Ranch!
notes.notes:
[h1]Skystead Ranch![/h1]
Skystead Ranch is a farming, building, animal-focused island adventure!

Take your place as the proud new owner of your very own Skystead Ranch! A lot of work is ahead to transform this collection of overgrown floating rocks into your very own beautiful animal sanctuary. The more you beautify, the wilder the variety of wacky and wonderful creatures will arrive to investigate their potential new home, caretaken by you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/38ad89b5211fffe1d719a7cd5aee5f83588d23de.gif[/img]

[h2]Who are we?[/h2]
We are ToastieLabs - a Small, Independent Games company from the UK. With only a small team of 4 and a cosy office in the Cold North, we all share a passion for games and making people smile.

With every game we release, from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/897330]Coloring Pixels[/url] to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1878910]WooLoop[/url], and now Skystead Ranch, we committed to providing experiences that are available to everyone, relaxing and high quality. We love supporting our releases with feedback and comments from our amazing community, and Skystead Ranch will be no exception!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44256831/814d8227119f65ad9416149eff6111da1512ddb9.png[/img]

[h2]Roadmap[/h2]
[h3]Next Fest Demo[/h3]
Like our previous titles, we are very excited to give you all hands-on playtime with a demo of SkyStead Ranch - Coming this October, you'll be able to play an early access, demo version of our Game! We will be looking forward to getting some feedback, so get ready to let us know what you think and what you'd like to see!

[h3]Crowd-Funding[/h3]
We need your help!
We are still just a small independent games company and this is our first ambitious, large project! To ensure we make this game the best it can possibly be, we are hoping to run a crowdfunding campaign during October's demo showcase.

Since we recently expanded to include a 4th member, we wanted to stretch our imaginations and make something even better than before! The design of Skystead Ranch has flexibility at its core so we can easily expand and shrink the scope of the game based on how much support the game gets. We have a minimum spec for the game that we are confident we can make without any crowdfunding help but we want to give this project every opportunity it deserves!

Stay tuned to find out more, we are going to turn October into a month-long ToastieLabs celebration! You won't want to miss out on any exclusive rewards, and free updates to our other games <3

[h2]Things to Look Out For![/h2]
Other than crowdfunding, which we will be announcing in full detail in the coming months, make sure you check out our game live at EGX London and MCM Comic Con* (to be confirmed) where we will be hosting live booths for you to play our game and meet us in person!


Make sure you add Skystead Ranch to your Wishlist to stay up-to-date with all the news and announcements for the upcoming release!
